stories.title: New affordable homes in Flintshire almost halve as Wales hits record high
stories.summary: The number of new affordable homes delivered in Flintshire almost halved last year, Welsh Government figures show. The county delivered 110 additional affordable homes between April 2025 and March 2026, down from 213 the year before. Only the Vale of Glamorgan, down 172, recorded a bigger fall in Wales. Across Wales, 3,865 additional affordable homes

stories.title: Met Office fog warning issued for Flintshire and Wrexham overnight into Monday
stories.summary: A yellow weather warning for fog has been issued for Flintshire and Wrexham from 6pm on Sunday until 11am on Monday. The Met Office said visibility could fall to around 50 metres or less in some places. The warning also covers Denbighshire, Conwy, Gwynedd, Cheshire West and Chester and Merseyside, along with much of England

stories.title: Flintshire remembers: Remembrance Sunday services and parades across the county today
stories.summary: Communities across Flintshire are holding Remembrance Sunday services and parades today. Roads are closing in nine towns and villages for the events, with the first closures from 9am and the last, in Flint, running until 4.30pm. In Connah’s Quay, people are asked to assemble at the Civic Hall from 9.30am and be seated by 9.55am

stories.title: Plans to demolish fire-hit former Elms Hotel in Sealand among latest Flintshire planning decisions
stories.summary: Plans to demolish the former Elms Hotel in Sealand have been submitted to Flintshire County Council. The application, registered on 3 November, covers the demolition of the former hotel building on Sealand Road. The derelict former hotel was destroyed in a large fire on the evening of 26 November 2024. North Wales Fire and Rescue

stories.title: Fog warning for Flintshire with visibility below 50 metres in places
stories.summary: The Met Office expanded its yellow warning into north east Wales overnight, with delays to buses, trains and flights possible.
